records.text: Jesus withdrew with His disciples to the sea, and a great multitude from Galilee followed; and from Judea,
He did not speak to them without a parable, but privately He explained everything to His own disciples.
The apostles gathered around Jesus and reported to Him everything they had done and taught.
Knowing their thoughts, He said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself is laid waste, and every city or house divided against itself will not stand.
